# @mission-platform/icons

"Write once, run on both frameworks" SVG icon components for Mission Platform.
Each icon is authored once in the framework-neutral JSX dialect
(`@mission-platform/forge-jsx`) and shipped as **both** a Vue 3 component and a React
component.

The `./react` and `./vue` subpaths are produced by **compiling the neutral
icons to each framework at build time** with the two-stage compiler in
`@mission-platform/vite-plugin-forge` (source-to-source → native compile), not the
runtime `toReactComponent` / `toVueComponent` adapters. A single `pnpm build`
produces the Vue and the React artifacts together (one per-icon JS chunk + one
per-icon CSS asset, so consumers tree-shake to just the icons they import).

The package also exposes a **framework-neutral `.` entry** that re-exports the
neutral icon source (typed against the built `dist/components` declarations; the
package `src` is published so the entry resolves). It is **not** a runnable
standalone build — it exists so a write-once `@mission-platform/forge-jsx` component
can `import { IconX } from '@mission-platform/icons'` and have it (a) type-check,
(b) render through the runtime adapters in unit tests, and (c) be remapped by
`@mission-platform/vite-plugin-forge` to the matching `./react` / `./vue` build in
the emitted per-framework output. App/library code that is not itself written in
the neutral dialect should keep importing the explicit `./react` / `./vue` subpath.

The neutral icons are a faithful port of the Vue SFC icons in
`@mission-platform/icons`: the same 24×24 stroke artwork, the same per-icon
default `aria-label`, and the same `@layer mp.icons` styling.

## Usage

```ts
// Vue 3
import { ForgeIconAlert, ForgeIconArrow } from '@mission-platform/icons/vue';

// React
import { ForgeIconAlert, ForgeIconArrow } from '@mission-platform/icons/react';

// Write-once neutral component (compiled per framework by vite-plugin-forge)
import { ForgeIconAlert, ForgeIconArrow } from '@mission-platform/icons';
```

Each icon renders an `<svg role="img">` (inside a centring `<div>` wrapper that
carries the `forge-icon-<name>` BEM class) on a `0 0 24 24` viewBox.

## Props

Every icon accepts:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `size` | `number \| string` | `'md'` | Width/height — a named token (`'2xs' \| 'xs' \| 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' \| 'xl' \| '2xl'` → 12–48px) or a pixel number. |
| `color` | `string` | `'currentColor'` | Stroke colour (and fill, for the filled-marker icons). |
| `ariaLabel` | `string` | per-icon default | Accessible name. When omitted the icon is `aria-hidden`; most icons also carry a sensible default label (e.g. `ForgeIconAlert` → `Alert`). |

Three icons add behavioural props:

| Icon | Extra props | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ForgeIconArrow` | `direction` (`'up' \| 'right' \| 'down' \| 'left'`, default `'up'`) | Rotates the arrow via an inline `transform`. Exports `IconArrowDirection`. |
| `ForgeIconChevron` | `direction` (`'up' \| 'right' \| 'down' \| 'left'`, default `'down'`) | Rotates the chevron via an inline `transform`. Exports `IconDirection`. |
| `ForgeIconSort` | `active` (`boolean`), `direction` (`'asc' \| 'desc' \| undefined`) | Fills the chevron matching the active sort direction. Exports `SortDirection`. |

## Storybook

Every icon is catalogued in **both** Storybooks under the dedicated top-level
`Icons` section, grouped by category (mirroring the `Icons/<Category>`
groupings used by `@mission-platform/icons` — `State / Status`, `Media`,
`Math / Quantity`, `Navigation / Controls`, `General UI`, `Map`, …; the icons
the `icons` package does not story fall back to `Text Formatting` / `Table` /
`General UI`). Titles are `Icons/<Category>/<Name>`, plus an
`Icons/Overview` gallery of the full set:

- **Vue** — co-located per-icon stories live in this package at
  `src/components/<icon>/<icon>.vue.stories.tsx` (consuming
  `@mission-platform/icons/vue`); they are globbed by `apps/storybook`.
- **React** — the matching per-icon stories live in the React Storybook app at
  `apps/storybook-react/src/components/<icon>/<icon>.react.stories.tsx`
  (consuming `@mission-platform/icons/react`).

Each story exposes `size`, `color`, and `ariaLabel` controls; the behavioural
icons add their own (`ForgeIconArrow`/`ForgeIconChevron`: `direction`; `ForgeIconSort`:
`active` + `direction`). Both files are generated by `scripts/generate-stories.js`
(`pnpm stories:generate`) — re-run it whenever icons are added or removed.

## Regenerating

The neutral icons are generated from the `@mission-platform/icons` Vue SFCs by
`scripts/generate-icons.js`:

```sh
node scripts/generate-icons.js
```

It re-creates one `src/components/<name>/` folder per source icon
(`<name>.tsx` + `<name>.module.scss` + `index.ts`) and rewrites the barrel
`src/components/index.ts` with the named re-exports the compiler discovers. The
three behavioural icons (`ForgeIconArrow`, `ForgeIconChevron`, `ForgeIconSort`) are emitted from
hand-written templates in the script; every other icon is a direct, faithful
translation of its source `<svg>`. Re-run it whenever the source icons change.
